name: Erup
subtitle: Native companion app for Pure Electric scooters
description: Live speed and battery, automatic ride logging, widgets, Live Activity and Control Center toggles over a Bluetooth link that reconnects on its own.

apps.name: Erup
apps.subtitle: Your scooter, at a glance.
apps.localizedDescription: Erup replaces the official Pure Electric app with a fast, native iOS app: a live dashboard, automatic rides with routes and charts, range from your own consumption, a battery health trend, widgets, a Live Activity, Control Center toggles and Siri shortcuts. Speed limits are never changed.
apps.versionDescription: Rebuilt Settings in the iOS style, a notification center you can clear, export of rides and sensor data for a period you choose, compressed ride storage, an iPhone-only app, larger-text and VoiceOver support, a clearer not-connected card, regenerative braking on the speedometer and exact lock and cruise confirmation.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Erup connects to your scooter over Bluetooth.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Erup asks for Face ID before unlocking your scooter or changing its PIN.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Erup records the route of your rides.
